description: Governor's Secretariat Central Province - Appointments Made by the Hon.Governor Central Province.
categorisation: This gazette contains ONLY government personnel appointments (naming specific individuals with their basic titles/positions) without detailing their portfolio responsibilities or describing government structural changes. The content lists appointments of named individuals to specific posts (e.g., "Provincial Director," "Secretary," "Acting Deputy Chief Secretary") but does not include descriptions of what these positions are responsible for in terms of subject areas or portfolio details.
